tagline: Farming and fabrication help in Tamil and English

common.offline: You are offline — showing saved data where available
common.errorBody: This screen hit an unexpected error. Your saved data is safe.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: Welcome! Tell us where your farm is so we can show local weather and market prices.
onboarding.locationError: Could not get your location. Choose your district below instead.
onboarding.locationUnsupported: This device cannot share its location. Choose your district below.
onboarding.privacy: Your exact location stays on this phone. Only a rounded ~1 km area is shared when a scan is synced.
onboarding.locationDenied: Location permission was denied. Choose your district instead.
onboarding.locationWhy: Your location is used for local weather and market prices. It is optional and stays on this phone.

home.weatherUnavailable: Weather is unavailable. Add an OpenWeatherMap key or check your connection.
home.tools: What do you want to do?
home.tagline: Farming and fabrication help in Tamil and English

sync.notConfigured: Cloud sync is not configured; records stay on this phone
sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.clearConfirm: Discard {count} record(s) that have not been uploaded? This cannot be undone.

model.awaitingBody: No validated model is installed yet. You can still pick the value manually below.
model.error: The model could not be loaded
model.scoreNote: Scores are raw model outputs, not calibrated probabilities.

scan.cameraDenied: Camera permission was denied. You can upload a photo instead.
scan.cameraUnsupported: Camera is not available on this device. Upload a photo instead.
scan.invalidImage: That image could not be read or is too small (minimum 64×64 pixels).
scan.lowConfidence: The model is not sure about this photo. Retake it in good daylight, close up.

problem.not_image: That file is not an image.
problem.too_large: That image is too large (maximum 15 MB).
problem.too_small: That image is too small (minimum 64×64 pixels).
problem.unreadable: That image could not be read.

soilScan.title: Soil scan
soilScan.instruction: Photograph bare, dry field soil in daylight, filling the frame.
soilScan.manualHint: Not sure? Ask your local agriculture office or use a soil health card.
soilScan.noGpsNoShare: No location is set, so this scan will not be added to the community map.

diseaseScan.title: Leaf check
diseaseScan.instruction: Photograph one leaf against a plain background, in daylight.
diseaseScan.scope: This model only knows tomato leaf conditions. Other crops will give wrong answers.

remedy.title: Guidance
remedy.consult: Confirm the problem with your local agricultural extension office, or call the Kisan Call Centre on 1800-180-1551 (toll-free), before buying any treatment.
remedy.disclaimer: Preliminary guidance only. A photo cannot confirm a disease. Do not mix or apply chemicals without expert advice and the product label.
remedy.notFound: No guidance is available for this condition yet.
remedy.urgent: Act quickly — this can spread fast

cropRecommend.title: Crop advice
cropRecommend.missingSoil: Soil type not given — ranking ignores soil.
cropRecommend.missingRain: No rain forecast — ranking ignores rainfall.
cropRecommend.scoreNote: Rule-based score from general crop requirements. It is not a probability or a yield prediction.
cropRecommend.disclaimer: General guidance only. Check with TNAU or your agriculture office before planting.
cropRecommend.subtitle: Ranked by simple, explainable rules
cropRecommend.phHint: From a soil health card, if you have one

water.ok: Water need matches what you have
water.bad: Needs more water than you have

risk.heavy_rain_sowing: Heavy rain forecast in the next 5 days — delay sowing until it passes.
risk.heavy_rain_low_water_crop: Heavy rain forecast — this crop dislikes waterlogging. Ensure drainage.
risk.no_rain_rainfed: No rain forecast in the next 5 days — rain-fed sowing is risky now.

mandi.title: Market prices
mandi.noData: No price records found for this crop and district.
mandi.noKey: Market prices need a data.gov.in API key (VITE_AGMARKNET_API_KEY). No sample prices are shown.
mandi.fetchError: Could not reach the price service.
mandi.liveNote: Agmarknet data via data.gov.in. Prices are reported by markets and may be delayed.
mandi.cachedNote: Saved copy from {time}. Could not refresh.
mandi.subtitle: Daily prices from regulated markets

failure.http: The price service returned an error.
failure.malformed: The price service returned unexpected data.

mandi.staleData: The newest price here is {days} days old. Prices may have changed.

map.title: Community soil map
map.noData: No community scans yet. Scans from validated models appear here after syncing.
map.notConfigured: Firebase is not configured, so no community data can be shown.
map.ratePrompt: Does this match the soil you know here?
map.signInNeeded: Ratings need cloud sync to be configured.
map.privacy: Each point is a ~1 km area, never an exact field location.
map.subtitle: Soil types reported by farmers' validated scans, with community ratings
map.howToAdd: Scan soil with location set and a validated model; confident results are shared after syncing.
map.noServiceCentres: Service centres and markets are not shown on the map because no verified location dataset is connected yet.
map.reviewPlaceholder: What do you know about the soil here?
map.reportBody: Why should this review be checked by a moderator?

error.no_key: Weather needs an OpenWeatherMap API key (VITE_OPENWEATHER_API_KEY).
error.invalid_key: The weather API key was rejected.
error.not_found: Weather is not available for this location.
error.network: Could not reach the weather service. Check your connection.
error.http: The weather service returned an error.

error.unsupported: Speech input is not available in this browser. Please type instead.
error.no_speech: No speech was heard. Please try again.
error.network: Speech recognition needs an internet connection.
error.error: Speech recognition failed. Please type instead.

farm.title: My crop
farm.noCropBody: Pick a crop from crop advice and tap "I planted this" to track its stages.
farm.checkInQuestion: Does your crop look like it is at "{stage}"?
farm.laggingAdvice: Check water, weeds and pests. If leaves show spots, try a leaf check, and talk to your agriculture office.
farm.reportQueued: Thanks — your update will sync when online
farm.stageNote: Stages are approximate and vary with variety, weather and care.

settings.title: Settings
settings.locationPrivacy: Stored on this phone, rounded to about 1 km.
settings.aboutBody: VIVA AI helps farmers and fabricators with soil, crop, market and drawing tools in Tamil and English.
settings.disclaimer: Advice is general guidance. Confirm with TNAU, your agriculture office or a qualified fabricator before acting.

fab.title: Maker drawings
fab.subtitle: Dimensioned drawings for simple steel parts
fab.requestHint: Example: "L bracket, legs 100 mm and 80 mm, width 40 mm, thickness 5 mm"
fab.noShape: Could not tell which part you need. Choose it below.
fab.unitAssumed: Some numbers had no unit and were read as millimetres. Please check them.
fab.unplaced: Heard but not placed: {values}. Enter them in the right boxes.

geometry.legA: Leg must be longer than twice the thickness
geometry.legB: Leg must be longer than twice the thickness
geometry.holeDia: Hole is too big for the part
geometry.boltDia: Bolt hole is too big for the tab
geometry.leafLength: Leaf must be longer than the pin knuckle
geometry.height: Height must be more than twice the thickness

fab.footer: All dimensions in mm · Print scale 1:{scale} on A4 · Mild steel ≈ {kg} kg
fab.disclaimer: Indicative drawing only, not a certified engineering design. A qualified fabricator must check sizes and load capacity.

materialFor.l_bracket: MS flat bar, bent, or MS angle
materialFor.hinge_mount: MS flat bar with round rod pin

fab.shareUnsupported: Sharing is not available here, so the PNG was downloaded.
fab.viewerHint: Drag to pan, scroll or use + / − to zoom. Keyboard: arrows, +, −, 0.
